purpose: Prespecified paired acceptance gates for the frozen imec0 rescue run

primary_target.interpretation: Match or exceed the existing imec0 pipeline yield without worsening quality guardrails

decision_rule.adopt_general_pipeline: All hard gates pass and n_ks_good >= 260
decision_rule.qualified_stream_policy: All hard gates pass and 234 <= n_ks_good < 260 only if at least two prespecified quality guardrails improve materially
decision_rule.reject_universal_default: Any hard gate fails; retain an imec1-specific rescue policy pending diagnosis

notes: The 10% KS-good tolerance is a qualification band, not an automatic pass.
The automatic holdout contains raw extrema without manual neural labels and is a preservation guardrail, not absolute neural recall.
Use the same pipeline policy and thresholds; do not copy imec1's explicit AP191 repair mask onto imec0.
